text.div:
Florida Blue BlueOptions 03768 - Prime EPO Plan

Carrier: GatorCare. Plan type: EPO. Period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

36 benefits are placed in CARIN SBC benefit categories. 11 benefits have no code in the SBC benefit category code system and are listed, by identity only, in the bps-unmapped-benefit extension.

Converted from Benefit Plan Standard document GATORCARE_PRIME_EPO (schema version 1.2.0).

Coverage Period: 01/01/2026 – 12/31/2026 | Coverage for: Individual and/or Family | Plans: Premium, Prime, Prime Plus, GatorCare Out-of-Area | GatorCare 2025 | Page 1

This plan provides Prescription Drug benefits for Prescription Drugs and Related Supplies provided by Participating Pharmacies. To receive Prescription Drug Benefits, you and your Dependents may be required to pay a portion of the Covered Expenses for Prescription Drugs and Related Supplies for each 34-day supply at a retail pharmacy or each 90-day supply at a retail or mail order pharmacy. That portion is the Copayment or Coinsurance.
Deductible | $125 Individual/$500 Family Pharmacy Calendar Year Deductible (CYD) must be satisfied for brand products for tiers 2 through 5. Pharmacy CYD is waived for Tier 0 and 1 medications.
Pharmacy deductible does not apply to Medical CYD but counts towards Medical Maximum Out-Of-Pocket (MOOP).
Out-of-Pocket Maximum | Pharmacy Out-of-Pocket Maximum accumulations are combined with Medical CYD, Coinsurance, Copays, and Per-Visit Deductibles. The values cross accumulate between all tiers.
Maximum Dollar Amount per Prescription | No Maximum
Maintenance 90-day claims filled at UF Health pharmacies will receive a reduced copay (2x copay) vs claims filled at retail (3x Copay)

Specialty Pharmacy | Get your specialty prescription drugs filled with best-in-class specialty pharmacy services including comprehensive programs to optimize patient treatment outcomes and your cost savings. The majority of specialty medications will now require prior authorization.
Emergency medical transportation | Deductible + 20% Coinsurance | Tier 1 Deductible + 20% Coinsurance | Tier 1 Deductible + 20% Coinsurance

Durable medical equipment | Deductible + 20% Coinsurance | Not Covered | Not Covered
